name: Ruined City of Dranik
summary: The shattered capital of the Dranik civilization, now a war‑torn ruin patrolled by Muramite forces and scarred by Discord rifts.
description: Once the proud heart of Dranik culture, the Ruined City of Dranik now lies broken under Muramite occupation. Discord energy tears through collapsed streets, temporal echoes replay ancient battles, and scattered survivors hide in the shadows of shattered citadels. Riftseekers maintain fragile arcane anchors to prevent total planar collapse.
